definitions.short: a family ; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow
definitions.full: H504. eleph I. [ אלֶף ֶ֫ ] noun masculine Psa 8:8 ; only plural cattle (Phoenician אלף , Assyrian alpu , COT Gloss ) — אֲלָפִים Prov 14:4 ; Isa 30:24 used in tillage; subject to man Psa 8:8 (|| צֹנֶה ); their increase אֲלָפֶיךָ שְׁגַר a blessing Deut 7:13 ; 28:4 , 18 , 51 (|| all צאֹנֶ֑ךָ עַשְׁתִּרֹת ).
